data.one_liner: Flutter bottom navigation bar widget with snake animation on item change.
data.what_it_does: Provides a bottom navigation bar widget featuring a snake animation effect when switching between different items. It supports custom shapes, gradients, colors, and behaviors like floating or pinned modes.
use_when: You want a bottom navigation bar with a smooth snake animation effect.
You need customizable shapes, colors, or gradients for selected and unselected navigation items.
avoid_when: You require the standard platform-default BottomNavigationBar without extra animations.
You are using SnakeShape.circle and strictly require selected labels to be shown.
strengths: Smooth snake animation on item change
Supports both color and gradient configurations
weaknesses: SnakeShape.circle forces selected labels to be hidden
Limited to bottom navigation bar use cases
